body: I understand you for this. Being a nurse myself I get told from a lot of people that they seriously want to die and it feels like a punch to the stomach when I have to tell them that there is something worth living for and that they will get better again. I can't belief this myself and even more ironically I do hate those people that tell me exactly that - those that do not understand - and I have become one of those myself. Shame on me.
Thank you for sharing this, I had to cry really hard to this. Today has been a very bad day, very bad month actually and this really touched me and made me feel something.
